REPORT UNREACHABLE CONTACT

🆘 Report an Emergency

Use this if you cannot reach an emergency hotline or your emergency contact. It builds a message with your details and location that you can copy and send however works on your phone — SMS, Messenger, or any app.

📱 SEND VIA SMS 💬 SEND TO PASIG KA-TXT
Tap "Copy Text" then paste the message into Messenger, Viber, or any app you use to reach your local DRRMO or barangay. "Send via SMS" opens your phone's messaging app with the report pre-filled so you can choose who to send it to. "Send to Pasig Ka-TXT" fills in the city's text line for you — use it when the hotlines are down.

Version 1.0 · Developed by Zayon Systems

About This App

Pasig Emergency Ready (PER) was created by Zayon Systems for the people of Pasig City — because in a crisis, every second counts. Instead of searching for the right number while an emergency unfolds, residents reach the right responder in one tap: the Pasig City Command Center, BFP, PNP, the City DRRMO, or their own barangay.

If a line is busy, the app immediately offers the next number to try. If calls will not go through or the internet is down, it can send a text with your location to Pasig Ka-TXT. PER works alongside the city's emergency system and 911 — it does not replace them.

App Features v1.0

✓One-tap Pasig emergency hotlines by emergency type
✓Backup call order — next number offered instantly if a line is busy
✓Text for Help: SMS to Pasig Ka-TXT with GPS location (no internet needed)
✓Official numbers update automatically, with "last verified" date
✓"In Case of Emergency" card for first responders
✓Personal emergency profile with photo
✓Barangay hotline for all 30 Pasig barangays, with extra numbers
✓Geotagged emergency camera with location & contact stamp
✓Family Emergency Plan builder
✓Nearest government & private hospital locator
✓Official alerts from OCD, PAGASA, NDRRMC & Pasig City DRRMO
✓Live Windy weather map
✓72-hour Go Bag checklist
✓Works offline after first open

Privacy & Data

Your profile, medical info, photos, and plans are stored only on your own device — PER has no servers and nothing you enter is sent anywhere unless you choose to send a text or share a photo. The app only downloads the official list of city hotline numbers. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data will erase this information permanently, so keep that in mind before doing either. Some features (Windy weather map, Facebook links, Google Maps directions) open outside services when tapped; those follow their own privacy practices once you leave the app.

Disclaimer

PER is intended to facilitate quick access to emergency contacts and personal emergency information. It does not replace emergency medical services or professional advice. Always call 911 in life-threatening situations.
